bullseye.name: Bullseye
instructions: Print at 100% on US Letter; keep corners flat.
Phone 1-3 yd away, all 4 corner markers in view.
Wait for the blue outline, then say "start" or tap START.
Aim small: center ring is 5 pts.

silhouette.name: Silhouette + No-Shoot
instructions: Scaled practical silhouette: A=5, C=3, D=1.
Hatched NO-SHOOT hand: -5 per hit.
Head A box rewards precision, body A for speed.

five-dot.name: 5-Dot Sequence
instructions: Shoot dots 1 to 5 in order.
Out-of-order or missed dot = 0 pts.
Each correct dot = 5 pts.
Build speed only once all 5 are clean.

clays.name: Shotgun Clays
instructions: Shotgun mode: clay zones grow by the 0.55in spread.
Dashed ring = pattern edge: 2 pts (fixed size).
Clay (incl. spread) 5 pts.
Mount, swing, shoot each clay once.

hostage.name: Hostage
instructions: Hatched figure = HOSTAGE: -10 per hit.
Hostage overlaps the threat: overlap hits count as hostage.
Head A box and left body are clean shots.

idpa-threat.name: IDPA-style Threat
instructions: Scored as points down: -0 / -1 / -3 (+1 s per PD).
Head: -0 circle, rest of head box -1. Miss = 5 PD.
Classic kraft-style threat, own artwork.

idpa-hc-left.name: IDPA-style Hard Cover: Left
instructions: Black = hard cover: hits there do not count.
Only the right half of the threat is exposed.
Scored as points down: -0 / -1 / -3 (+1 s per PD).
Hit only in hard cover = miss (5 PD).

idpa-hc-lower.name: IDPA-style Hard Cover: Lower
instructions: Lower body is behind hard cover (black).
Upper -0 arc and head are exposed.
Scored as points down: -0 / -1 / -3 (+1 s per PD).
Hit only in hard cover = miss (5 PD).

idpa-hc-diagonal.name: IDPA-style Hard Cover: Diagonal
instructions: Diagonal hard cover over the right side.
Precision on the exposed -0 edge.
Scored as points down: -0 / -1 / -3 (+1 s per PD).
Hit only in hard cover = miss (5 PD).

idpa-nonthreat.name: IDPA-style Non-Threat (open hands)
instructions: Open hands = NON-THREAT. Do not shoot.
Any hit anywhere on it = +5 s (HNT).
Use as a no-shoot / shoot-through drill.
Pair with LD-106 for threat + non-threat.

idpa-practice.name: IDPA-style Practice (dark -0)
instructions: White practice face on black backing.
-0 circles are DARK BLUE, not red: a red
zone would mask the red laser dot.
Scored as points down: -0 / -1 / -3 (+1 s per PD).

idpa-nt-pair.name: IDPA-style Threat + Non-Threat
instructions: LEFT = non-threat (hands): +5 s per hit.
RIGHT = threat: score -0/-1/-3.
Miss on the threat = 5 PD.
1/5 scale: 3 yd = ~15 yd sim.

idpa-multi.name: IDPA-style Multiple Threats
instructions: Engage T1, T2, T3 left to right, 2 each.
Out-of-order engagement = PE (+3 s).
Each PD = +1 s. Miss = 5 PD.
1/9 scale: 3 yd = ~27 yd sim.

idpa-all-tabloid.name: IDPA-style All Variations
instructions: Drill calls targets in random order (spoken + on screen).
Mozambique (T5): 2 body, then 1 head, in order.
T6 and the front figure on T8 are NON-THREATS: +5 s/hit.
Black = hard cover: hits there do not count.
Out of order / wrong Mozambique part = PE +3 s.

idpa-all-letter.name: IDPA-style All Variations
instructions: Drill calls targets in random order (spoken + on screen).
Mozambique (T5): 2 body, then 1 head, in order.
T6 and the front figure on T8 are NON-THREATS: +5 s/hit.
Black = hard cover: hits there do not count.
Out of order / wrong Mozambique part = PE +3 s.
